title: 새벽 러닝
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track at 95 BPM in G Major. The arrangement features a bright, syncopated electric piano riff playing jazz-influenced chords. A clean, funky electric guitar performs rhythmic muted strums and occasional melodic fills. The drum kit consists of a punchy kick drum, a crisp snare, and sixteenth-note hi-hat patterns. A melodic synth bass follows the kick drum pattern with a rounded, sub-heavy tone. Male vocals alternate between rhythmic rapping in the verses and melodic singing in the chorus. Production includes subtle record scratch effects and vocal doubling on the hook.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[bright electric piano riff, syncopated drum beat, funky electric guitar strums]
(Ooh-na-na-ni)
(Hey-ey-ey-ey)
(Yeah, uh)

[Verse 1]
[male rap vocals]
새벽 다섯 시 알람이 몸을 일으켜
어젯밤 스타 타임라인이 아직 눈에 남아
동기는 대리 달고 후배는 해외 발령인데
나는 아직 여기 같은 책상 같은 모니터 앞
이불 속에서 비교하다 새벽이 오더라
남의 속도에 맞추다 내 페이스를 잃었어
운동화 끈을 묶어 한강으로 나가볼게 (Yeah)

[Chorus]

한 발짝 크게 점프
